0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons (4-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) are on a one-game winning streak and visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 15th in the East) for this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, with Brooklyn having lost four straight. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
